trueNorthDef: Compass bearing of blueprint -Z (plan north). Plan north points 10.43 degrees east of true north. Geographic east/north map into the pre-shift frame by x = E*cos(theta) + N*sin(theta), z = E*sin(theta) - N*cos(theta), theta=-10.43 deg.

pixelAnchor.note: NW corner of the OSM north wall, which is the competition-gym north wall on the site plan

entrance.note: South smaller-glass threshold per 23:20 correction; full 107ft south glazing, 15ft longer than prior vestibule. Provisional +/-3ft.

osm.note: Footprint is the OSM outline rotated onto the building axes and snapped to 0.5 ft. The 4-degree kink in the south wing is squared off.
